title: Protein Crystallization Screen Builder
author: Opentrons, Ricardo Padua, Brandeis University
materials: step 1- For water and each of up to 8 reagents in reagents csv, transfer designated volumes to designated wells of the crystallization plate in slot 9.

steps.title: Transfer reagents to plate
steps.instruction: Using a p300 single‑channel pipette for volumes ≤300 µL and a p1000 single‑channel pipette for larger volumes, transfer the custom volumes (20 µL – 2 mL as specified in the input CSV files) of water and each of up to eight stock reagents to their designated wells of the 96‑deep‑well crystallization plate placed in slot 9.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the specified volume of water to each target well.
For each of the up to eight reagents listed in the reagents CSV, transfer the designated volume to the appropriate wells.

steps.title: Mix plate wells (optional)
steps.instruction: If desired, perform a mixing step on all wells of the crystallization plate to ensure homogeneity of the transferred solutions.
